statement: The function returns a result r and r = min_{p : {0,...,n-1} -> {0,...,n-1}} ( Σ_{j=0}^{n-1} nums[p(j)] + x * max_{j=0}^{n-1} ((j - p(j)) mod n) ), where n = len(nums) and (a mod n) denotes the remainder in {0,...,n-1}.
preconditions: The general constraints: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000, for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9, and 1 <= x <= 10^9.
